scientific.integrity: The vector field was checked against the primary article. The Lie-derivative identity and baseline coefficients were replayed by a dependency-free exact polynomial checker; the equality case was reconstructed analytically from stationary generator identities for \(w^2\), \(uv\), and \(vp\). No finite trajectory is used as proof.
limitations: The result applies to compactly supported invariant probability measures and does not prove boundedness or existence of a non-equilibrium attractor.
The slab conclusion is a necessary support condition; it is not a pointwise trapping statement.
Literature searches reduce but cannot eliminate the risk of an unindexed or differently phrased prior derivation.
